entries.title: Production Learning assessment routing repaired
entries.summary: The private Learning portal was repaired after its production assessment route fell back to a development-only loopback address and Cloudflare rejected the request with error 1003. The Sites runtime now connects explicitly to the civic Worker, production routes refuse local-only addresses, and non-JSON upstream failures are converted into clear structured errors instead of exposing a browser parsing exception. The failed request generated no assessment, changed no Learning record, and consumed no AI allowance. All 66 release tests passed before publication.
